blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱381.71 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱26.27 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. According to the PCSO results, the Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 33-44-28-03-20-36, with a jackpot prize of ₱381.71 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers.
